domain_hint: general personal/consumer email: transactional receipts and account notices, security/account alerts, newsletters and marketing (split by product/service type), job alerts and professional networking, event/webinar invitations, personal correspondence, and local/community content — no specific business domain should be assumed; let the intents reflect whatever is actually in the sample.

intents.label: Retail & Shopping Promotions
intents.description: Marketing emails from retail/e-commerce brands (clothing, home goods, electronics, grocery) advertising sales, discounts, or new arrivals.
example_subjects: Save Up to 40% During Our Labor Day Sale
ALL dresses are 50% off
Extra 30% off gear for hiking, fishing, & more.

intents.label: Travel & Hospitality Promotions
intents.description: Marketing emails promoting cruises, hotels, car rentals, or vacation deals.
example_subjects: This is it! Last chance to get vacations from $299
Haiyong: Check out your latest account summary
The clock is ticking on up to $750 in savings

intents.label: Financial Services Marketing
intents.description: Promotional or informational emails from banks, investment firms, or financial newsletters offering products, insights, or credit line news.
example_subjects: Good news — your credit line has been increased
Don't miss this chance to get a $500 bonus offer
Semi-retirement: Work less, live more

intents.label: SaaS/Tech Product Newsletter
intents.description: Newsletters or promotional content from software, AI, or tech companies about products, features, or industry content.
example_subjects: One console. Every agent. Every laptop.
Save 40% on Microsoft programs with Coursera Plus
Causal AI, SafeChat, DRAM Bypass, JEP 540...

intents.label: News & Media Digest
intents.description: Daily or periodic news roundups and briefings from media outlets covering finance, world events, or general news.
example_subjects: Nepal flood deaths rise
早间市场快报：美股小幅下跌
Waiting on Warsh

intents.label: Real Estate Listings & Alerts
intents.description: Automated property listing notifications, open house invites, and saved home updates from real estate platforms.
example_subjects: Open House: 30 Lake Avenue #207, Saratoga Springs, NY
New listing in Clifton Park at $475K
Sold Home: 42 Westchester Drive

intents.label: Job Alerts & Professional Networking
intents.description: Automated job postings, LinkedIn notifications, and networking/career platform messages.
example_subjects: Senior Software Engineer - Agentic AI at NVIDIA
Oracle EBS Lead at Americhem
GlobalFoundries teammates have a Zip invite waiting

intents.label: Event & Webinar Invitations
intents.description: Invitations, reminders, or follow-ups for meetups, conferences, webinars, or professional courses/programs.
example_subjects: Data & AI and App Development Meetup: Amazon Bedrock Session
Build your Frontier Transformation Week agenda
Last chance to apply | MIT Professional Education: TLP

intents.label: Security & Account Alerts
intents.description: Notifications about sign-ins, password/verification requests, account changes, or domain/service expirations.
example_subjects: Security alert
Your confirmation code
Reminder: Your Domain(s) Will Expire Shortly

intents.label: Transactional Receipts & Purchase Notices
intents.description: Order confirmations, purchase/debit card usage alerts, statements, and review requests tied to a specific transaction.
example_subjects: Your debit card was used
Maybank Securities FX Daily Statement
Give us the scoop on your recent purchase.

intents.label: Local & Community Content
intents.description: Neighborhood social platform posts, community group updates, and local organization events (e.g., Nextdoor, school district).
example_subjects: I was walking on the sidewalk and a woman made...
2026 CCC Summer BBQ!
2026–27 School Year Transportation Update

intents.label: Personal Correspondence
intents.description: Direct personal emails or forwarded messages between individuals, not automated or marketing content.
example_subjects: Fwd: GF Photonics

intents.label: General Interest Newsletter
intents.description: Blog-style or content newsletters on lifestyle, self-help, hobbies, or general interest topics not tied to a specific product/service.
example_subjects: What Anxiety Is Trying to Tell You
Can You Fly With Plants?
Need distractions? Try these on us.

intents.label: Productivity & App Notifications
intents.description: Automated notifications from productivity tools, calendars, or community/social apps about activity or reminders.
example_subjects: You have no events scheduled today.
caydengineer mentioned you in Mentra Community
"Dynamic.html dashboard"

intents.label: Other/Uncategorized
intents.description: Emails that do not clearly fit any other category, including ambiguous, spam-like, or unclassifiable content.
example_subjects: RICHES ARE IN NICHES
From $100/month to $10K/month
